rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ reports that on the afternoon of the 14th 公明党 held an extraordinary national convention and elected 竹谷とし子氏 new representative, the delegates' confidence being given by a show of all hands on the 中央幹事会's recommendation under rule 17-4 ('出席代議員の挙手総員による信任を得て竹谷新代表が選出された').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It reports that at the convention 竹谷代表 declared her resolve ('席上、竹谷代表は').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says the convention was held because in January 斉藤鉄夫前代表 joined 中道改革連合 and the representative's office fell vacant in mid-term ('今年1月に斉藤鉄夫前代表が中道改革連合に参画し、代表が任期途中に欠けたことを受け').
